The club was established in 1949, and since 2007 it has been run by businesswoman [[Alona Barkat]], who serves as the club's owner. The club also fields youth teams, and a women's side. There is also a football academy.{{cite web|title=Profile of Hapoel Be'er Sheva in UEFA|url=https://www.uefa.com/nationalassociations/teams/59340--h-beer-sheva/|publisher=UEFA|access-date=30 May 2016}} The home uniform colors of the club are red and white. Until 1959, the club played its home games at a stadium that was located in the old city of [[Be'er Sheva]]. In 1960, the club moved to [[Vasermil Stadium]]. Starting from the [[2015–16 Israeli Premier League|2015–16]] season, the home ground of the team is [[Turner Stadium]]. The club began to win titles in the 1970s. Throughout the years, the team has won six [[Israeli Premier League|championships]], four [[Israel State Cup|State Cup]], four [[Toto Cup]] (One in [[Liga Leumit]]), six [[Israel Super Cup|Super Cup]] (One in the Second Division) and one [[Lilian Cup]]. [[Be'er Sheva]] is also the first team in the history of Israeli football to play in a European competition, together with [[Beitar Jerusalem F.C.|Beitar Jerusalem]], and the first team in the history of Israeli football that played in the [[UEFA Europa League|UEFA Cup]] together with [[Hapoel Tel Aviv F.C.|Hapoel Tel Aviv]]."}}
